about: The chat settings window over a panel (issue #1157): it's drawn over every panel, so it takes the clicks in its frame. The inventory is dragged under where chat settings opens, then the equipment window opens on top of the Esc order. A click on Party Chat's box in the settings unticks it: on main the inventory under it took the click and was raised to the top of the Esc order instead. Party Chat is ticked again and everything closed at the end.
